verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's own agentic workflows act automatically on alert events: they auto-remediate level 1 alerts and auto-escalate high-risk or complex cases for human review. It also lets users configure the risk-score equation and screening configurations. However, nothing documents a user-facing rule builder that maps events to actions, and Starter Plan agent configurations cannot be customized. Webhooks such as WORKFLOW_COMPLETED only notify external systems, so they are building blocks rather than rule-triggered actions. Missing for 10: a documented user-definable event→condition→action rule engine, evidence of which automated actions users can configure, customization depth beyond the Starter Plan, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
